room_description: A well-lit, modern living room with beige patterned wallpaper, a white sofa setup, a dark wood coffee table, a TV stand with a decorative ship, a display cabinet, and a study desk with a computer.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the living room.
Finding a blue rubber band hidden between the sofa cushions.
Collecting a pair of scissors from the top drawer of the display cabinet.
Opening the middle cabinet drawer to get a roll of yellow tape.
Using scissors to cut open the sofa cushion, retrieving a blue flash drive.
Solving the flower picture puzzle to reveal the hidden code '6540'.
Opening the safe behind the picture frame to get the red keycard.
Solving the 'Quickspot' puzzle on the computer.
Entering '4681' into the wooden box lock.
Retrieving the screwdriver from the wooden box and using it to unscrew the wall vent.

solution_steps: Get the scissors from the display cabinet.
Use the scissors on the patched-up tear on the white sofa cushion.
Collect the blue USB flash drive hidden inside.
Find the rubber band (sofa) and tape (cabinet).
Go to the framed picture of flowers on the left wall.
The picture morphs into a grid. Apply the colored tape/bands to the grid lines based on the visual clue on the wall (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue borders).
Plug the flash drive into the computer on the desk.
Play the 'spot the difference' minigame on the screen.
Click the 5 differences between the two images to reveal the code '4681'.
Enter '4681' into the wooden box in the desk area.
Use the screwdriver on the metal vent cover located near the floor.

final_action: The player removes the metal vent cover using the screwdriver and crawls into the ventilation shaft to escape the room.
